uncertainties.note: Two distinct 'king' usages kept apart deliberately: the villain's source word (kanji 'become king') stays lowercase 'king' as a generic ambition, while the source's katakana 'kingu' (dialogue_09710/09813) is capitalized 'King' as Cynthia's nickname for Gainer, per batch_04478.json's existing note that 'King' is King Gainer's own title. No new identity invented, only the existing corpus convention applied.

Bystander interrupts an apparent Eureka/Renton exchange (09724 uses 'Renton and I', 09725 'the two of us'); none of these four rows are speaker-tagged. Rendered literally without assigning the interrupting line (09722/09723) to a specific named speaker.
Source addresses 'Gain-san'; addressee/speaker not tagged; honorific rendered as 'Mr. Gain' per existing corpus practice for -san. Who is speaking to Gain is not settled by neighbouring rows.
